source.title: Aircraft Situation Display to Industry: Functional Description and Interface Control Document for the XML Version
source.referenced_source: The document points to the FAA ASDI service site for the XSD set and sample messages; current availability/version of those XSDs was not verified.

documented_requirements_not_implemented.header: 32 bytes: 16-byte timestamp, then network-order 32-bit data type, sequence number, compressed size and decompressed size.
documented_requirements_not_implemented.sequence: 0..100000 inclusive with restart/reset behavior described in section 5.3.
documented_requirements_not_implemented.payload: zlib-compressed XML; ASDI preamble and feed-specific messages require the referenced XSD set.
documented_requirements_not_implemented.required_fields_and_extensions: Per-message required/optional fields and namespace/schema extensions are defined by ASDI.xsd and imported schemas; those schemas and an ASDI-specific decoder are absent from this profile.

interfaces.tested_scope: oa-xml tests cover generic bounded XML 1.0 parsing and security refusals only. They do not validate the ASDI header, zlib framing, heartbeat, XSD, namespace contract, or ASDI message types.

documented_profile.format: Version 1.7 specifies an XML subset for index, public reroute and FEA/FCA files; elements have start/end tags, no attributes, and may appear in any order where allowed by the documented parent relationships.

interfaces.tested_scope: Generic oa-xml parser tests are not TFMDI conformance tests. oa-tfms tests exercise SWIM TFMData namespaces and message structures, not ETMS-TFMDI-003. No TFMDI profile support is claimed.

tested_scope.message_examples: All 37 examples in NAM Rev G Part II sections 3.1.1 through 3.8.2 are represented by tests; one printed POA example is explicitly refused as defective and the corrected form is separately tested.
tested_scope.message_set: The 25 Part II Table 2 core messages; Part II 2.2.6 candidate future message mnemonics are explicit refusal vectors (Mnemonic, LRM code 60). Other messages and per-partner attachments are refused/not implemented.
tested_scope.timing_sequence: Deterministic session tests cover named IRD timers, response deadlines, message-number sequencing and workload arithmetic; test timestamps are synthetic inputs, not legacy observations.
tested_scope.legacy_comparison: No comparison to unavailable ERAM/NAM production messages or live traffic is made.
